written: Written by Claude (claude-opus-5-5) on 2026-11-27, before any demo run on this video, from still frames: contact sheets of the source video (a frame every 4 s, the chosen segment every 3 s), event boundaries checked on the cut file at 1 s spacing with exact frame times, and a few frames viewed at full size. main: events marked main are the ones a report must name (acceptance test, PLAN.md 2.4)

events.what: Flight along a two-lane highway through a steep forested valley. Cars and lorries are on the road; a yellow mobile crane stands on the highway with its boom out over a bare slope, and a queue of vehicles is stopped near it.
The wreck at the foot of the embankment: a yellow lorry cab on its side and a long white trailer among rocks, snapped trees and debris, with workers in orange vests beside it.
events.found_if: a crashed, wrecked or overturned lorry/truck (or its trailer) on or below the slope

events.what: Looking down on the crane parked in a coned-off lane with its outriggers down and workers on the road; a basket hangs on the slope below. From about 63 s the boom reaches out over the slope; the trailer is at the bottom of the frame from about 60 s.
The lorry's cab hangs from the crane's cable above the trees on the slope, higher in later frames (being lifted, inferred).
events.found_if: a truck or truck cab being lifted, hanging from or carried by a crane

events.what: Wider view of the crane on the highway: workers in high-visibility vests around it, cones closing the lane, a tow truck and other vehicles behind; the cab still hangs beside the road.
The white trailer hangs nose-down from the crane beside the road (being lifted, inferred), with workers standing on the highway.
events.found_if: a truck trailer being lifted, hanging from or carried by a crane

events.what: A queue of stopped lorries and cars waits further along the road beyond the trailer.
